prohibitedLiteralsCarveOut.pattern: one frozen array literal of rejected environment-variable names, REJECTED_ENV_KEYS, whose only member is the string PILOT_APPROVAL_RUN_TOKEN, plus exactly one refusal site per refusal stage (stage 1 before the .env load, stage 2 after it), both reading that same frozen array
prohibitedLiteralsCarveOut.rule: The walker permits exactly these two occurrences, in exactly this file, inside exactly this pattern, and fails on a third occurrence anywhere, on an occurrence in any other file, on an occurrence outside that pattern, and on any read of the variable's value. Presence is an own-property test on the environment object, never a truthiness or value test, so a set-but-empty value refuses identically. The value is never printed, logged, hashed, digested, length-measured, compared, persisted, receipted, reported, written to any dashboard payload or artefact, or forwarded; only the key name may appear.
prohibitedLiteralsCarveOut.refusal: PILOT_CONFIG_REJECTED_ENV_KEY, exit 2, in EVERY falcon.js invocation (pilot and non-pilot), raised from stage 1 if the key is inherited from the process environment and from stage 2 if the .env load introduced it, before any browser or context launch, any dashboard start, any pilot manifest read, any run artefact creation or modification, and any target or provider contact; the stage-2 .env read through the existing configuration path is the only accepted application filesystem access before refusal (rev 21 section B)
prohibitedLiteralsCarveOut.scopeNote: Rev 21 section B replaces the rev 20 B1..B7 scope. This intentionally converts a previously ignored environment variable into an explicit configuration error in every invocation; the reason code stays PILOT_CONFIG_REJECTED_ENV_KEY for both stages.
inversionTests: neg-token-refusal-stage1-inherited: the key inherited in the process environment is rejected with exit 2 and reason PILOT_CONFIG_REJECTED_ENV_KEY before the .env load
neg-token-refusal-stage2-dotenv: the key absent from the inherited environment but present in .env is rejected identically immediately after the configuration load
neg-token-refusal-empty: the key set to the empty string is rejected identically in both stages
neg-token-refusal-nonpilot-run: a plain non-pilot run (node falcon.js --no-dashboard) with the key present is rejected with exit 2, proving the refusal is not scoped to pilot mode
neg-token-refusal-order: the refusal is asserted on the ordered event log to precede browser launch, dashboard start, any pilot manifest read, any run/ write and any target request
neg-token-refusal-silence: the value string appears in no log line, report, receipt, dashboard payload or artefact
neg-token-refusal-no-measure: no hash, digest, length or comparison of the value exists anywhere in the refusal path
neg-token-refusal-carveout: a third occurrence of the literal, in this or any other file, or either occurrence moved outside the permitted pattern, fails AC-084

appendText.text: Amended by rev 21 (SEC-20 m-73): validation condition 2 is replaced by the C3.4b capability-escape model. A child_process function identified by binding is a capability value tracked within its module through parameters, default parameter values, assignments and destructuring, object properties, array elements and returns; it is validated only where it is ACTUALLY INVOKED (receiving a capability is not invoking it), and it must then have a literal listed executable and argv resolving to literal arrays at every such call site. The checker fails closed when the capability is returned, exported, stored on an escaping object, passed to a non-local function, never invoked, or reached by any unknown or unanalysable path. The real GitInfo flow in src/core/history/GitInfo.js must be resolved across BOTH hops: the default value of the destructured parameter at :34, forwarded to the local runGit at :39 and :44, invoked at :21. Fixtures and controls, including the forwarding-escape fixture and the real two-hop positive control, are enumerated in table C6-T of rev 21 section C. Nothing is risk-accepted by this item and no execution is claimed.

## Appendix R21 (rev 21, closing the SEC-20 m-68 residual)

**Authority rule.** This tracked document is the sole authority for every deferred 18P-PROTECTED-NONGET text. No acceptance criterion, requirement, merge condition or open item depends on any tag or historical commit remaining reachable. Short commit identifiers that appear in this record, including inside text preserved verbatim from earlier revisions, are **historical context only and are not dependencies**; the earlier proposal of an annotated tag carrying the rev 17 criterion text is **WITHDRAWN** - no such tag is created, pushed, cited or relied on.

**Deferred content check.** The verbatim copies required by the 18P-DOC merge condition are unchanged by rev 21: the eleven wholly deferred criteria, the deferred clauses of the eight mixed criteria, the rev 17 text of the seven criteria that lost sentences, the OWNER-12 and OWNER-13 deferred-work lists, the approval-writer research, the relevant SEC-04 to SEC-20 findings including the m-51 and m-52 conditions, the SPIKE-R facts and the deferred test obligations. Rev 21 adds nothing to the deferred scope and removes nothing from it.

**Rev 21 corrections that touch quoted text here.** Where a preserved copy cites "fourteen inversion fixtures with one positive control" or "rev 19 section C", the quotation is left **verbatim** because its purpose is preservation; the live rules are rev 21 section C (C3.4b child_process capability-escape model and fixture table C6-T, the single source of truth for fixture ids and counts) and rev 21 section D (the unchanged rev 6 exit precedence, under which exit 13 masks none of 18, 17, 16 or 15 and never masks a pilot-store integrity violation). `PILOT_APPROVAL_RUN_TOKEN` is, in Phase 18, rejected on presence in every `falcon.js` invocation with exit 2 and reason `PILOT_CONFIG_REJECTED_ENV_KEY`; nothing in this deferred record authorises reading, measuring, storing or forwarding its value.

**Status.** Non-normative for Phase 18, non-production, unshipped, not authorised and not scheduled.
